title: Consumer credit-card spending
scope: U.S. large banks; quarterly purchases; not seasonally adjusted
summary: Quarterly cumulative credit-card purchases less returns at reporting large banks. Excludes cash advances and balance transfers. This measures purchase spending, not balances owed, and is not a census of all U.S. cards.

details.source: Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia via FRED
details.transformation: Five exact quarterly observations verified on the public FRED series page; quarter-start dates follow FRED time-series convention. Runtime refresh uses the public CSV.
details.license: FRED series tagged Public Domain: Citation Requested
details.limitations: Not seasonally adjusted; quarter-to-quarter changes include seasonal effects. Partial snapshot history until CSV refresh succeeds.
